dedupe_keys.name: noaa digital coast critical facilities in coastal flood and sea level rise zones

description: These NOAA Digital Coast datasets give coast-focused aggregated totals of law enforcement facilities, fire stations, medical facilities and schools, derived from the U.S. Geological Survey's structures inventory, for study areas defined by FEMA flood zones and sea level rise inundation within coastal counties. Two datasets are listed, the USGS National Structures Dataset counts and critical facilities in the FEMA Special Flood Hazard Area (100-year floodplain), with a data description, data dictionary and coastal county definitions; the vintage shown is 2021 and the format comma-separated values, downloaded through NOAA's Quick Report tool alongside socioeconomic data such as American Community Survey estimates and coastal economy figures. Coverage: coastal counties of the United States. Access: free through Quick Report. Licence: public domain. Caveats: aggregated counts, not facility points, tied to the source structures inventory at the time. Simulation uses: screening the exposure of critical facilities to coastal flooding and sea level rise by county. Related records: the USGS National Structures Dataset.
